source: WRDS Compustat comp.secd.prccd; primary U.S. security; dated security ticker COST; 2026-09-24

request.sql:
SELECT d.gvkey, c.conm, d.tic, d.iid, d.datadate, d.prccd, d.curcdd
FROM comp.secd AS d
JOIN comp.company AS c ON c.gvkey=d.gvkey
WHERE d.tic=%s AND d.iid=c.priusa AND d.datadate=%s
ORDER BY d.gvkey,d.iid
LIMIT 2
